Players Committee card image of [[Dathomir: Maul's Chambers]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “'''Light Side:''' Jar Jar and your spies (except Ezra) may not deploy here. Opponent may not Force drain here.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Dathomir%20Maul%27s%20Chambers.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Dathomir Maul's Chambers.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
